title: Bifurcations for Lagrangian systems and geodesics I
summary: This paper is Part I of a two-part series. We investigate bifurcation phenomena in Lagrangian systems with various boundary conditions and constraints, focusing on the interplay between Morse theory and the existence of multiple solutions through three principal configurations: Lagrangian trajectories connecting two submanifolds or with endpoints related by an isometry, and brake orbits in Lagrangian systems.
